title: Been traveling in the same dream environment (hotels, hallways, skyscrapers) for 3+ years
content: I am always in the very top of a skyscraper in a misc city, its very futuristic, like modern white interior but neon-like lights, but very luxurious and regal looking. A hotel, luxury apartment, casino, resort? Theres a hotel-like bar where there is a dress code and people without faces. I am always trying to not be seen in the lobby. I am always at the very top of this skyscraper. Sometimes it is "wobbly" with a feeling of doom coming, othertimes that doesnt exist and there is a neutral feeling inside. There is an elevator that goes down, and everytime I walk into it, its like I am accepting the possibility I may die going down. But I always go in. And right before it goes down, I like hold onto the walls for my life- and then right before I die, I wake up with my heart beating so fast and very scared. Other times it is a smooth ride down and then I dont remember anything. Sometimes people are in with me, usually I am alone. In waking life, I am not afraid of heights or elevators. But its interesting how night after night, I still go into the elevator despite knowing I may die but taking the risk anyways lol &#x200B; I am unsure if its the same building, but I am also often locked in a very seedy, 1970s-like motel room that I am not supposed to be in. Sometimes my dog is with me too. Other times I am floating around apartment complex's and whatnot, but never going inside. &#x200B; Then the last place I frequent is empty, cold hallways in the basement of a highschool-like building or something.
